subject: MSA + Order Form kickoff — starter action sheet & evidence list
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@lumenix.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-09-21T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff: MSA + Order Form — starter packet & evidence

Hi Rishi / Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited to move forward. Attaching our standard MSA (Lumenix_MSA_v1.pdf) and a signer list (Lumenix_Signer_List.xlsx). Before we jump into redlines, procurement asked if you can share a short starter action sheet: the minimal artifacts you need from us to get the onboarding and billing set up, plus any must-have security evidence (SOC2, DPA, data residency notes).

Quick context: we expect two signing authorities (see signer list), onboarding target is mid-October, and we have a preference for EU residency for certain workloads but will flag that later in the order form.

Could you: 
- Confirm the set of evidence items you need to validate (SOC2, pen test, encryption-at-rest, KMS options)?
- Share any template or redline conventions you prefer (track changes vs annotated PDF)?
- Provide an intake sheet we can fill (party names, billing contact, PO flow)?

Happy to hop on a 30-min kickoff if helpful — our procurement is available Wed/Thu mornings PT.

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Head of Procurement | Lumenix Systems
alex.turner@lumenix.com
Attachments: Lumenix_MSA_v1.pdf (application/pdf), Lumenix_Signer_List.xlsx (spreadsheet/xlsx)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@lumenix.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-09-21T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Kickoff: MSA + Order Form — starter packet & evidence

Alex — thanks for sending these over and for the clear timeline. Looping in Marissa from Customer Success to coordinate onboarding and signer logistics.

Short answers up front:
- Evidence we typically require to hit onboarding (minimum): SOC 2 report (Type II) or equivalent report, current external penetration test summary, confirmation of encryption at rest + in transit, and a KMS/HSM integration plan if keys are customer-managed. If you have an internal compliance binder, send that and we can map items.
- Redline convention: We prefer an annotated PDF for initial pass (quick comments) + a tracked Word for substantive legal changes. Either is fine; annotated PDF speeds review.
- Intake sheet: attaching an intake-action-sheet.xlsx for party/billing/signer capture — please fill and return.

Operational asks from our side:
1) Billing contact (name + email + billing address).
2) Primary technical contact for onboarding (for infra/residency questions).
3) Any export-control or residency constraints for the workloads you mentioned (flag which environments need EU residency).

We will do an internal quick read and return an annotated first-pass redline by EOD tomorrow. If Wed/Thu mornings PT work for you, Marissa will propose a 30-min slot.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Attachment: intake-action-sheet.xlsx (spreadsheet/xlsx)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@lumenix.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-09-21T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Kickoff: MSA + Order Form — starter packet & evidence

Alex — quick initial pass attached.

On Sun, Sep 21, 2025 at 11:02 AM Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Alex — thanks for sending these over and for the clear timeline. Looping in Marissa from Customer Success to coordinate onboarding and signer logistics.
> 
> Short answers up front:
> - Evidence we typically require to hit onboarding (minimum): SOC 2 report (Type II) or equivalent report, current external penetration test summary, confirmation of encryption at rest + in transit, and a KMS/HSM integration plan if keys are customer-managed. If you have an internal compliance binder, send that and we can map items.

Notes on the attached redline (RI_Redlines_annotated.pdf):
- Section 2 (Term/Termination): flagged a customer-favorable termination at will clause — recommend limiting to 60 days and adding a cure period.
- Data residency: added an annotation to Exhibit A asking team to confirm which environments require EU-only processing; that will determine order-form scoping and routing.
- Liability cap: proposing standard template cap (12 months of fees) — will call this out in tracked Word if you want to discuss.
- Customer-supplied IP clause: suggested tighter language around customer data ownership + permitted uses for model training (we do not train on customer data without explicit consent).

I attached the annotated PDF for speed. If you prefer, we can produce a tracked Word with substantive edits after you review annotations.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Attachments: RI_Redlines_annotated.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@lumenix.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@lumenix.com>
Date: 2025-09-22T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Kickoff: MSA + Order Form — starter packet & evidence

Thank you — Kimberly (and team), this is helpful and much appreciated.

We filled the intake-action-sheet and attached it (returning Lumenix_Signer_List_completed.xlsx). Procurement confirms they can provide SOC 2 Type II and a pen test summary — attaching the procurement mailbox in case you need direct copies.

DocuSign: our legal says they prefer DocuSign for signatures; inserting an embedded link below for initial signer flow once the final doc is ready.

Proposed next steps:
- Please send back a tracked Word with substantive redlines where you want hard edits (liability cap, termination language, IP/data use).
- Marissa: can we book a 30-min kickoff Wed 2025-09-24 9:30am PT? That works for procurement and our tech lead.

Thanks again — we’ll attach the completed signer list and the intake sheet in a follow-up if anything else is needed.

Best,
Alex Turner
Head of Procurement | Lumenix Systems
